text: Compost enriches soil, enhancing its structure and nutrient content, while mulch regulates moisture, maintaining optimal conditions for plant growth. By creating a weed-free environment, compost and mulch work in tandem to ensure a productive garden. Compost, rich in organic matter, improves soil fertility and aeration, promoting the growth of a diverse range of plants. Mulch further guards against moisture loss and suppresses weed growth, allowing compost to maximize its benefits. As compost decomposes, it releases essential nutrients back into the soil, supporting plants with rich, dark, and crumbly soil. In addition, the natural decay process of compost creates a healthy habitat for beneficial microorganisms, further enhancing soil health and productivity.
summary: Compost enriches soil, mulch regulates moisture, weed-free, productive.
